title: Why Forget Him, Who Does Not Overlook
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 289
summary: Seva is carried here from why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts? toward o Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels performing, transactional, dry, because it keeps seva inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Seva steadies when o Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kiau bisarai j ghaal na bhaanai ||
lines.translation: Why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kiau bisarai j keeaa jaanai ||
lines.translation: Why forget Him, who acknowledges what we do?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kiau bisarai jin sabh kichh dheeaa ||
lines.translation: Why forget Him, who has given us everything?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kiau bisarai j jeevan jeeaa ||
lines.translation: Why forget Him, who is the Life of the living beings?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kiau bisarai j agan meh raakhai ||
lines.translation: Why forget Him, who preserves us in the fire of the womb?
By Guru's Grace, rare is the one who realizes this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kiau bisarai j bikh te kaaddai ||
lines.translation: Why forget Him, who lifts us up out of corruption?
Those separated from Him for countless lifetimes, are re-united with Him once again.
Through the Perfect Guru, this essential reality is understood.
O Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him. ||4||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: why forget Him, who does not overlook our efforts?.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside by Guru's Grace, rare is the one who realizes this.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: o Nanak, God's humble servants meditate on Him.
